result.summary: The page is largely well-designed, but the horizontal carousels ('Fastest near you' and the category filter chips) clip content at the right edge without a clear visual affordance, and the 'Trattoria Piccol...' restaurant name is truncated mid-word without an ellipsis, which looks visually broken.

issues.description: The restaurant card 'Trattoria Piccol' in the 'Fastest near you' carousel is cut off at the right screen edge, and its title is truncated mid-word without an ellipsis, making it look broken rather than intentionally scrollable.
issues.suggestion: Add a right-edge fade/gradient or partial-card peek to signal horizontal scrollability, and apply text-overflow ellipsis to restaurant titles so truncation looks intentional.

issues.description: The category filter chip row ('All', 'Pizza', 'Sushi', 'Burgers', 'Healthy') is clipped at the right edge with a partially visible chip, giving no clear indication that more categories exist.
issues.suggestion: Show a subtle gradient mask or scroll hint on the right edge of the chip row to indicate additional scrollable content.

issues.description: The '-100%' discount badge on the bottom pizza card is ambiguous and could be confusing (a 100% discount implies the item is free, which is unlikely).
issues.suggestion: Verify the intended promotion and use clearer copy such as 'Free item' or a specific discount percentage.
